pypdf 7.1.0, https://pypi.org/project/pypdf/7.1.0/
Bundled unmodified for local extraction of the public orthography PDF,
because Claude, ChatGPT and skill hosts do not install Python packages.
See PYPDF-LICENSE.txt (BSD-3-Clause). No orthography book text is bundled.
Refresh with tools/vendor_pypdf.py.
